headline: WTI Crude Rises to $102.78 Amid Heightened Middle East Tension
summary: West Texas Intermediate crude futures rose 2.8% to $102.78 a barrel as escalating tensions in the Middle East raised fears over global oil supply disruptions.
why: WTI crude is a global petroleum benchmark, impacting energy sector costs, global inflation, and transport pricing.

impacts.name: Crude Oil
impacts.why: Supply disruption risks in major producing regions push up crude futures prices.

why_moved: Geopolitical instability in key oil-producing regions increases risk premiums on energy futures.
